column5: Fish waste rots fast. Compost it in the green bin.
Fish scraps are organic and break down naturally.
Raw meat scraps are biodegradable food waste.
Fruit scraps make good compost.
Peels break down quickly in compost.
Vegetable trimmings are biodegradable.
Spoiled produce is still compostable.
Egg shells are biodegradable.
Bread is food waste. It belongs with the BIO items.

column1: # ---- REC (clean packaging that can be reprocessed) ----

column5: PET bottles are recyclable. Empty them first.
Metal cans can be melted and reused.
Glass is recyclable again and again.
Glass jars are recyclable.
Flattened cardboard is recyclable.
Clean paper is recyclable.
Thin plastic bags are usually not accepted for recycling.
Styrofoam is non-recyclable.
Multi-layer sachets cannot be recycled.
Straws are too small and light to recycle.
Cigarette filters are plastic and not recyclable.
Soiled tissue cannot be recycled.
Batteries leak toxic metals. Hazardous waste only.
Bulbs have glass shards and sometimes mercury.
Pressurized cans can explode and hold chemicals.
Lighters hold flammable gas.
